instruction: Clear all browsing history entries related to mathsisfun.com.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully created a desktop shortcut for the 2048 game page. Navigated Chrome menu (3-dot → Cast, save and share → Create shortcut) and confirmed the dialog in 10 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Chrome menus, interact with dialogs, use Chrome built-in features (shortcut creation, menu navigation)
metadata.task_rationale: Clearing history requires using Chrome's 'Delete browsing data' feature accessible from the 3-dot menu, which is the same menu the agent successfully navigated in the trajectory. Tests data management capability.
metadata.explanation: Task requires clearing browsing history for mathsisfun.com. The config opens Chrome with the 2048 page, creating history entries. Evaluator checks that history entries matching 'mathsisfun' keyword have been deleted.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (get_history) correctly extracts all browsing history URLs from Chrome's SQLite History database by querying 'SELECT url, title, last_visit_time FROM urls'.
Metric (check_history_deleted) correctly checks that no history URL contains the keyword 'mathsisfun', returning 1.0 if all related entries are cleared and 0.0 if any remain.
Expected parameter handling is correct: type='rule' causes get_rule to return the rules dict directly, and the metric accesses rule['type'] and rule['keywords'] without extra nesting.
Config properly creates history entries by opening https://www.mathsisfun.com/games/2048.html, ensuring there is state to verify against.
Coverage is complete: the single instruction requirement (clear mathsisfun history) is fully verified by keyword-based URL scanning across all history entries.
